text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $77.8k with minimal daily movement, while Ethereum is essentially flat, suggesting consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed index at 34 with a 20-point drop over a week signals sustained fear despite stable price levels, and BTC dominance at 60% indicates capital is rotating away from altcoins into bitcoin defensively. Volume at $91B is moderate, consistent with a market waiting for directional clarity rather than committing to a new move.
